summary: Initializes a structure: delegates sub-struct initialization at this+0x90 to ThunkWithStructInitSubCalls, zeroes four byte fields (offsets 0x0, 0x1, 0x41, 0x61), then writes a sentinel dword (-190986834 = 0xF49C952E) into three consecutive dword fields at offsets 0x84, 0x88 and 0x8C. Return the sentinel value -190986834 stored in result.

unresolved: Concrete object type and field semantics are unknown; the four zeroed bytes and the triple sentinel dwords form an unverified initialization contract.
